ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar shows raw translation keys 'nav.newChat' and 'nav.atlas' instead of translated labels. Root cause: t('nav.atlas') returns the key itself (not undefined) when missing from translations, so the `t(key) || fallback` OR-short-circuit never fires. Keys 'nav.newChat' and 'nav.atlas' are NOT defined in /app/frontend/i18n/translations.ts (only nav.home, nav.market, nav.news, nav.profile, nav.learn, nav.ai, nav.community, nav.mentors exist). Fix: EITHER add 'nav.newChat' and 'nav.atlas' entries to en/fr/es sections of translations.ts OR change fallback to explicit check (e.g., const label = translations[lang][key] ?? navItem.label).

The 'Chat / Modules / Progress' segmented header (from old learn tab) is still visible at the top of the Atlas view and overlaps visually near the sidebar-toggle hamburger. In the new sidebar-first architecture, this internal tab bar looks redundant / cluttered. Consider removing the top segmented control since nav is now via sidebar.

issues: Top 'Chat/Modules/Progress' segmented header overlaps visually with sidebar hamburger icon at 22px from top-left; feels vestigial given the new sidebar navigation model

action_items: Add missing translation keys 'nav.newChat' (New Chat / Nouveau chat / Nuevo chat) and 'nav.atlas' (Atlas AI) to en/fr/es blocks in /app/frontend/i18n/translations.ts — OR — fix the fallback logic in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx lines 55 and 78 (t() returns key on miss, so `t(k) || fallback` never falls back).
Optional: remove or hide the vestigial 'Chat / Modules / Progress' segmented header at the top of learn.tsx now that navigation is done via the left sidebar.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx Sidebar component makes a fresh fetch to /api/vip/permissions on every mount/token change (line 30) — consider caching in a store or using the existing VIP permissions hook to avoid duplicate calls on every tab switch.

Sidebar uses Dimensions.get('window') once at module load (IS_WIDE constant) — this won't update on window resize on web; use useWindowDimensions() hook so the sidebar auto-expands/collapses when the user resizes the browser.
translations.ts is 5786+ lines — split by feature/namespace (nav.*, atlas.*, vip.*) into separate files to keep it maintainable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New sidebar layout is stable. All data-testids on sidebar are wired correctly (RN Web testID -> data-testid). Only pending issue is two missing translation keys (nav.newChat, nav.atlas) causing raw keys to appear as sidebar labels. To reproduce: login as VIP -> see left sidebar top items show 'nav.newChat' and 'nav.atlas' instead of 'New Chat' and 'Atlas AI'. To verify a fix: after adding keys or fixing fallback, page.evaluate on /learn should NOT contain 'nav.newChat' or 'nav.atlas' text.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the sidebar label bug: the languageStore.t() function returns the requested key itself when the key is missing (see /app/frontend/store/languageStore.ts line 97: `const raw = translations[language]?.[key] || translations['en']?.[key] || key;`). In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx line 55 and 78, the code does `t('nav.newChat') || 'New Chat'` and `t(navItem.labelKey) || navItem.label` expecting `t()` to return falsy for missing keys, but it always returns a truthy string (the key). Since 'nav.newChat' and 'nav.atlas' are not registered in translations.ts, they appear verbatim. Home/Market/News/Profile work because nav.home/nav.market/nav.news/nav.profile ARE defined in translations.ts. Fix options: (A) add the missing keys to translations.ts en/fr/es sections, (B) change t() to return null/undefined on miss and let call sites handle fallback, or (C) rewrite sidebar to use direct labels without t() for the two missing keys.
